notes.title: (Temporary) Patch for Auto-Unlocking Bugged Achievements
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30719317/dda0689467a822cd68fca485b5182a08a5d7abce.jpg http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30719317/df7fa2dce0ad5cb6c62dc22426888e6919b238bd.jpg http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30719317/8dcd06b641dca0a26ecaa0fa6a687a7aeb476767.jpg

Just to update everyone, we have pushed the above promised temporary patch update. Once you update the game and play it a few seconds/minute, it will automatically unlocked the much reported bugged Achievements (Monster Hunter, Coin Collector, King of Olympus and God of Olympus).  

This is a temporary patch available ONLY TILL THIS WEEKEND (Sunday, 18th Feb 2018) to automatically unlock the achievements for you.  
Starting next week, we are expecting to ship our new version of the Game (which will host various Dota 2 mini-fangames) and as such, the achievements will be completely revamped to match the new game system (conditions and icons).  

We will release a second game-mode update (another major change) after 2-3 weeks again. 

Currently, we are working on these 2 kinds of game modes:

1. Arcade Platformer 
You play as dota 2 heroes and have to dodge falling objects and keep climbing on them while surviving (think of tetris except that you need to climb on tetris blocks and keep surviving from hitting ground). 
Currently single player, with plans to add multiplayer mode to allow player interactions (jumping on/off each other or pushing each other away to make them hit falling objects and die) 

2. Shooting-Survival
Featuring Sniper and then expanding to a few more ranged heroes, you need to surive hordes of meele heroes by shooting/killing them (think of top-down zombie shooter, except ours in 3rd person or angular camera). Again, single player fist and with enough interest multiplayer. 

We will be able to provide some content updates and in-development progress in coming days to seek more feedback. 
If we get enough player interest, we will keep adding more fun game modes to turn this into a collection of different and many small but fun dota 2 fan games.

We advise everyone who wanted to get the bugged achievements unlocked to do so within this week/end itself.  

We will release a sneak peak of our first main game mode in next day(s).

notes.title: Improvements and Changes to Achievement requirements
notes.notes:
Patch released with the following changes:  

1. Total coins achievement has been capped at 500 now (reaching 500 unlocks later achievements too earlier requiring 600, 800 and 1000 coins).  
2. Total monster kill requirements is now changed to 5,10,15,20,25 total.  
3. Community stats should now be updated and be finished, unlocking all community achievements.
